Ashfall Junction Safe hub · Old West · 26 rooms

An Old West boom town where the roads between worlds meet: the Silver Spur Saloon, shops, temple, Chrome Clinic, guild and the Hall of Rebirth. Almost every room here is safe from combat.

Ways in and out: Ashfall Square (farm) leads to Farm Gate in Sunny Acres Farm; Ashfall Square (down) leads to Buckstars Entrance in Buckstars Coffee Shop; Ashfall Square (oldwest) leads to Gulch Gate in Tombstone Gulch; Ashfall Square (fantasy) leads to Blimble Gate in Blimble Hollow; Ashfall Square (future) leads to Proving Grounds Gate in The Proving Grounds; Ashfall Square (modern) leads to Portal Plaza in Modern District; Ashfall Square (prehistoric) leads to Portal Landing in The Primeval Rift.

Surface 26 rooms

Whisperwood Levels 1 to 7 · Fantasy · 18 rooms

An enchanted forest of goblins, wolves and herbs. The classic first hunting ground, with a safe camp for resting.

Ways in and out: Hermit's Clearing (west) leads to Winding Path in Blimble Hollow; Winding Path (east) leads to Ghoul Warren in Barrow Crypts.

Surface 18 rooms

Barrow Crypts Levels 4 to 9 · Fantasy · 16 rooms

Skeletons, ghouls and a warlord beneath the fallen chapel. Stone corridors and a quiet reliquary.

Ways in and out: Ghoul Warren (west) leads to Winding Path in Whisperwood; Winding Path (east) leads to Witch Lights in Sunken Marsh.

Surface 16 rooms

Sunken Marsh Levels 8 to 13 · Fantasy · 16 rooms

A fetid marsh east of the forest stream: leeches, crocodiles, a hag and a hydra. Great for fish and herbs.

Ways in and out: Witch Lights (west) leads to Winding Path in Barrow Crypts; Winding Path (east) leads to Hedge Maze in Thornwild Court.

Surface 16 rooms

Redrock Trail Levels 12 to 16 · Old West · 14 rooms

Outlaw country east of Ashfall, with the town of Dry Gulch and its Rattlesnake Saloon. Outlaws and Red Jack Calloway guard the crossroads to the Dunes and Frostpeak.

Ways in and out: Hanging Tree (west) leads to Dusty Trail in Tombstone Gulch; Dusty Trail (east) leads to Mine Entrance in Silverado Mines.

Surface 14 rooms

Silverado Mines Levels 12 to 17 · Old West · 16 rooms

A gold-rush mining camp reached from the Old Quarry, with the Lucky Strike Saloon. Cave spiders, claim jumpers and a golem-guarded forge. Best place for ore and silver.

Ways in and out: Mine Entrance (west) leads to Dusty Trail in Redrock Trail; Dusty Trail (east) leads to Bank Lobby in Dry Gulch Bank.

Surface 16 rooms

Sunscorch Dunes Levels 18 to 24 · Fantasy · 16 rooms

A desert of mummies and sphinxes with the Dune Bazaar, a wraith obelisk, ruins and the pharaoh's tomb below.

Ways in and out: Dune Bazaar (west) leads to Winding Path in Thornwild Court; Winding Path (east) leads to Gatehouse Barracks in Castle Frankenstein.

Surface 15 rooms

Underground 1 room

Frostpeak Station Levels 24 to 30 · Sci-fi · 19 rooms

A research outpost on an ice moon: cryo-beasts, a snowbound pass and the Cryo Titan's hall. Gear up at the station hangar.

Ways in and out: The Cryo Titan's Hall (west) leads to Service Walkway in Starship Aurora; Starship Tharsis: Cockpit (launch the starship) leads to Martian Landing Pad in Mars; Service Walkway (east) leads to Ember Gate in Ember Wastes.

Whole area 3 rooms

Surface 16 rooms

Ember Wastes Levels 30 to 34 · Sci-fi · 16 rooms

A volcanic colony world of ash, lava and plasma creatures, ending at the Magma Titan's caldera.

Ways in and out: Ember Gate (west) leads to Service Walkway in Frostpeak Station; Service Walkway (east) leads to Dusty Dune in Mars.

Surface 16 rooms

Shattered Citadel Levels 35 to 38 · Fantasy · 16 rooms

A fallen castle ruled by the undead Dread Marshal. Its throne hides the stair to the Abyss.

Ways in and out: Watchtower Top (west) leads to Winding Path in Nightfall Hollow; Winding Path (east) leads to Kelp Forest in The Drowned Reach.

Surface 16 rooms

The Abyss Levels 39 to 40 · Sci-fi · 14 rooms

The void between the worlds: stalkers, horrors and the Voidlord, the final boss.

Ways in and out: Edge of Nothing (west) leads to Service Walkway in Mars; Service Walkway (east) leads to Windy Plain in Exterminus.

Surface 14 rooms

Tombstone Gulch Levels 10 to 14 · Old West · 16 rooms

A ghost town off the Redrock Trail, with the Silver Dollar Saloon, a general store and Sheriff Whitlock. Ghost outlaws, skeleton deputies and Ghost Marshal Dalton in the bank vault.

Ways in and out: Gulch Gate (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction; Dusty Trail (east) leads to Hanging Tree in Redrock Trail.

Surface 16 rooms

Thornwild Court Levels 15 to 19 · Fantasy · 15 rooms

A fey realm of briars and mushrooms beyond the marsh causeway, with the Moonwell, the Pixie Market and Warden Sylwen. Pixie thieves, fey hounds and Thorn Queen Mab.

Ways in and out: Hedge Maze (west) leads to Winding Path in Sunken Marsh; Winding Path (east) leads to Dune Bazaar in Sunscorch Dunes.

Surface 15 rooms

Starship Aurora Levels 22 to 26 · Sci-fi · 16 rooms

A crashed starship in the Sunscorch Dunes, with a survivors galley, a med bay and a quartermaster. Security drones, mutated crew and the ship mind Helix on the bridge.

Ways in and out: Crew Quarters (west) leads to Service Walkway in The Proving Grounds; Service Walkway (east) leads to The Cryo Titan's Hall in Frostpeak Station.

Surface 16 rooms

The Drowned Reach Levels 27 to 31 · Fantasy · 15 rooms

A sunken kingdom beneath the frozen waterfall, with the Tidal Chapel, the Pearl Market and Captain Marrow. Drowned sailors, sirens and the Leviathan of the Reach.

Ways in and out: Kelp Forest (west) leads to Winding Path in Shattered Citadel; Winding Path (east) leads to Golden Bank in Poseidon's Realm.

Surface 15 rooms

Brimstone Rail Yard Levels 32 to 36 · Old West · 14 rooms

A hellish railroad depot past the Basalt Steps, with the Brimstone Saloon Car and Stationmaster Cobb. Coal demons, imp conductors and the Brimstone Express itself.

Ways in and out: Coal Yard (west) leads to Dusty Trail in Dry Gulch Bank.

Surface 14 rooms

Dry Gulch Bank Levels 15 to 17 · Old West · 7 rooms

A frontier bank beside the Rattlesnake Saloon. Hold up tellers and customers, kill Bank Manager Ebenezer Crane for the vault key, then unlock and loot the vault. The Bank Robbery contract from Slick Sam can be repeated.

Ways in and out: Bank Lobby (west) leads to Dusty Trail in Silverado Mines; Dusty Trail (east) leads to Coal Yard in Brimstone Rail Yard.

Surface 7 rooms

Modern District Levels 10 to 16 · Modern · 96 rooms

Step up through the arch in Ashfall Square into a modern strip: the Multi-Mart superstore with departments, Westfield Shopping Center, Sunset Acres Trailer Park, burgers, hot dogs, soda and two gas stations with restrooms, plus Meridian Tower, an eleven-level office building (a basement and ten floors, reached by elevator) whose top-floor CEO is guarded by three bodyguards. Modern gear, shoppers, stockers, trailer park brawlers and corporate zombies.

Ways in and out: Portal Plaza (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction; the lobbies have an elevator (type elevator) to every floor, from the basement to floor 10; City Block (east) leads to Auditorium 1 in Multiverse Cinema 12.

The Proving Grounds Levels 1 to 40 · Bots · 14 rooms

A fenced training field behind a little gate in the Ashfall back alley (type in). The resident adventurers Zeph and Rook train here so they stay out of everyone else's way, and it is full of monsters from every level. You are welcome to visit.

Ways in and out: Proving Grounds Gate (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction; Service Walkway (east) leads to Crew Quarters in Starship Aurora.

Surface 14 rooms

The Primeval Rift Levels 21 to 28 · Prehistoric · 22 rooms

Step into the mysterious portal at the Mirage Gate in the Sunscorch Dunes (enter portal) and you arrive in a prehistoric valley of tree ferns, tar pits and dinosaurs: raptors, pterosaurs, triceratops, stegosaurs, allosaurs, a spinosaur and Rex the Tyrant. Dr. Mara Quill runs the camp at the landing.

Ways in and out: Portal Landing (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction; Game Trail (east) leads to Cave Mouth in The Mammoth Caverns.

Surface 22 rooms

Mount Olympus Levels 86 to 100 · Fantasy · 61 rooms

The home of the Greek gods (not Athena, but the Titan Cronus is chained in Tartarus): 60 rooms in a 10 x 6 grid from sunlit foothills to the Throne of Olympus. Twelve gods in their halls (Hera, Ares, Apollo, Artemis, Aphrodite, Hephaestus, Hermes, Demeter, Dionysus, Hestia, Cronus), with Zeus as the primary boss. The heroes of Greek myth (Odysseus, Achilles, Heracles, Perseus, Orpheus and Atalanta) give the quests.

Ways in and out: Windy Meadow (west) leads to Winding Path in Hades; Winding Path (east) leads to Frosty Landing in Asgard.

Surface 61 rooms

Asgard Levels 88 to 100 · Fantasy · 61 rooms

The realm of the Norse gods across the Bifrost: 60 rooms from the rainbow bridge to Valhalla and the high seat. Thor, Loki, Frigg, Freya, Freyr, Baldr, Heimdall, Tyr, Bragi, Njord and Hel, with Odin the All-Father as the primary boss. Ragnar Lodbrok, Lagertha, Sigurd, Beowulf, Brynhildr and Leif Erikson give the quests.

Ways in and out: Frosty Landing (west) leads to Winding Path in Mount Olympus; Winding Path (east) leads to Airy Walk in Castle in the Clouds.

Surface 61 rooms

The Otherworld Levels 70 to 84 · Fantasy · 51 rooms

The Irish Otherworld: 50 rooms of mist meadows, the Fae wood, the sidhe mounds and the court of the Tuatha De Danann. Pixies, leprechauns, brownies, the Fae, banshees and Fomorian giants, and the gods (the Dagda is the primary boss, plus Lugh, the Morrigan, Nuada, Aengus, Brigid, Manannan and Balor of the Evil Eye). Cu Chulainn, Fionn mac Cumhaill, Oisin and Niamh give the quests.

Ways in and out: Shimmering Glen (west) leads to Winding Path in Avalon and Camelot; Winding Path (east) leads to Wailing Shallows in Hades.

Surface 51 rooms

Avalon and Camelot Levels 66 to 78 · Fantasy · 51 rooms

Arthurian legend: 50 rooms of Camelot village and castle, the Round Table, the Lake of the Lady, the mist-shrouded Isle of Avalon and Stonehenge. Black and Green Knights, the Questing Beast, Morgan le Fay (who carries Excalibur) and Mordred (primary boss). King Arthur, Merlin, Lancelot, Guinevere, Galahad, Percival and the Lady of the Lake give the quests. Merlin and Odysseus offer the two quests that tie Olympus, Asgard, the Otherworld and Camelot together.

Ways in and out: Sunny Green (west) leads to Winding Path in Atlantis; Winding Path (east) leads to Shimmering Glen in The Otherworld.

Surface 51 rooms

Atlantis Levels 62 to 74 · Fantasy · 41 rooms

The sunken city beside Poseidon's Realm: 40 rooms in an 8 x 5 grid of coral gardens, a pearl boulevard, a crystal quarter and the royal citadel, all underwater. Atlanteans (guards, scholars, priests, soldiers, nobles, champions and crystal golems) serve King Atlas (boss). Archivist Thales gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Coral Walk (west) leads to Winding Path in Poseidon's Realm; Winding Path (east) leads to Sunny Green in Avalon and Camelot.

Surface 41 rooms

The Pink Flamingo Levels 23 to 32 · Modern · 16 rooms

A nightclub in the modern realm: a velvet-rope entrance, bar, dance floor, stages, DJ booth, VIP lounge and back rooms, full of dancers, bouncers, a DJ, patrons and high rollers, run by the owner, Vinnie "Flamingo" Valentino (boss). Candy the bartender gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Pink Flamingo Bar (west) leads to City Block in Golden Years Manor; City Block (east) leads to Fan Entrance in Championship Wrestling Federation.

Surface 16 rooms

Championship Wrestling Federation Level 80 · Modern · 24 rooms

A giant wrestling arena (level 78 to 85): lobby, merch stand, concessions, ringside, the ring, entrance ramp, locker rooms, managers' offices and the World Champion's own locker room. Wrestlers, managers, valets, referees and announcers, and the reigning World Champion Maximus Stone (boss), who wears the World Championship Belt (a belt slot). Promoter Max Maxwell gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Fan Entrance (west) leads to City Block in The Pink Flamingo.

Surface 24 rooms

Multiverse Cinema 12 Levels 11 to 18 · Modern · 19 rooms

A movie theater: the modern realm (`modern` at Ashfall Square): 18 rooms with a lobby and box office, concession stand, arcade, five auditoriums showing fake movies (`movies`, then buy a ticket and `watch`), a projection booth, a VIP lounge, a film vault and the manager, Gary "No Refunds" Pomeroy, plus rowdy moviegoers, ushers, critics and popcorn thieves.

Ways in and out: Auditorium 1 (west) leads to City Block in Modern District; City Block (east) leads to Treadmill Row in BroGym.

Surface 19 rooms

Exterminus Levels 60 to 78 · Sci-fi · 92 rooms

A planet of 91 rooms ruled by the Exterminators: metallic, sentient robots with laser rifles who drop unobtainium. reached on foot through the future realm (`future` at Ashfall Square). Scavenge wreckage for unobtainium (level 20 Scavenging), then have a ripperdoc build or upgrade implants with it (`install`, `augment`). Scavenger Quinn gives the quests; the boss is Exterminator Prime, Unit 001.

Ways in and out: Windy Plain (west) leads to Service Walkway in The Abyss; Service Walkway (east) leads to Wind-scoured Gulch in Pluto.

Surface 92 rooms

Blimble Hollow Levels 1 to 10 · Fantasy · newbie area · 31 rooms

A cheerful village of little green folk, the Blimbles, in mushroom houses, and the perfect first adventure: the fantasy gate at Ashfall Square (`fantasy`). 30 rooms in a 6 x 5 grid: a safe village with a market, bakery, healer and inn, the Berry Meadow, the Gloomwood and Witherwood Hill, ending at the tower of Grimbold the Gloom, an evil wizard, and his evil cat familiar Shadowpaw. Elder Bumbleberry gives a six-quest chain.

Ways in and out: Blimble Gate (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction; Winding Path (east) leads to Hermit's Clearing in Whisperwood.

Surface 31 rooms

Castle in the Clouds Level 100 · Fantasy · 60 rooms

A palace of storm and sunlight above a giant magic beanstalk: the far end of the fantasy realm (`fantasy` at Ashfall Square). 60 rooms in a 10 x 6 grid of cloud steps, rainbow terraces, storm battlements and sky halls, home to thunderbirds, firebirds, cloud giants and stormcallers. Bosses: Raijin the Great Thunderbird, Pyra Queen of the Firebirds and Aelric the Stormking. Jack Beanstalker at the top gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Airy Walk (west) leads to Winding Path in Asgard.

Surface 60 rooms

Sunny Acres Farm Any level · Farm · 15 rooms

A peaceful working farm just out of Ashfall: type `farm` in Ashfall Square. Till, plant and harvest vegetables in the fields, milk the cows in the Red Barn, shear the sheep in the pastures, and sell it all to the old farmer at the Farmer's Market. 15 rooms in a grid. Four tradeskills (tilling, planting, milking, shearing) with a master farmer's reward at level 20: denim overalls and a golden hoe. The farmer, cows and sheep are level 50: kill them and you are banned from the farm for an hour.

Ways in and out: Farm Gate (out) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction.

Whole area 15 rooms

BroGym Levels 12 to 19 · Modern · 21 rooms

A huge neon gym south of the Westfield Food Court in the modern area (go south). 20 rooms in a grid: lobby, locker rooms, free weights, bench press, squat racks, a boxing ring, cardio, spin and yoga studios, a juice and protein bar and a pro shop, packed with weightlifters, powerlifters and bodybuilders (men and women) to fight for XP. Boss: Brock "The Mountain" Lunkman.

Ways in and out: Treadmill Row (west) leads to City Block in Multiverse Cinema 12; City Block (east) leads to Activity Room in Golden Years Manor.

Surface 21 rooms

Poseidon's Realm Levels 50 to 70 · Fantasy · 52 rooms

An underwater kingdom of mermen and mermaids ruled by Poseidon, lord of the deep, and his son Triton. 50 rooms in a grid: sunlit shallows, kelp forest, coral reef kingdom, the trench and the palace. Enter with `down` from the Abyssal Trench in the Drowned Reach. Nereus at the Whirlpool Landing gives the quests and runs a small shop.

Ways in and out: Golden Bank (west) leads to Winding Path in The Drowned Reach; Winding Path (east) leads to Coral Walk in Atlantis.

Surface 52 rooms

Hades Levels 80 to 100 · Fantasy · 61 rooms

The underworld: demons, devils and evil spirits under Nyx, goddess of the night. 60 rooms in a grid, from the banks of the Styx and the Fields of Asphodel through the Pits of Tartarus to the Palace of Night. Enter with `down` from the Count's Crypt in Nightfall Hollow. Charon the Ferryman gives the quests and runs a shop.

Ways in and out: Wailing Shallows (west) leads to Winding Path in The Otherworld; Winding Path (east) leads to Windy Meadow in Mount Olympus.

Surface 61 rooms

Pluto Level 100 · Sci-fi · 60 rooms

A frozen sci-fi world of Plutonians, at war with Mars. 60 rooms in a grid, from the Martian Beachhead through the frozen trenches and the Plutonian city to the Warlord's fortress. Reach it from Mars: east of the Twisting Passage is the Martian Fleet Dock, where the warship Crimson Fang flies to Pluto (`in`, then `launch` on the bridge). Captain Blip at the beachhead gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Wind-scoured Gulch (west) leads to Service Walkway in Exterminus.

Surface 60 rooms

Castle Frankenstein Levels 31 to 38 · Horror · 37 rooms

A gaunt castle on the ridge east of the witch circle in Nightfall Hollow (go east from the Cauldron Pit). 36 rooms on three levels: a courtyard, graveyard and great hall; the laboratory tower above, where Dr. Victor Frankenstein rages among the lightning rods; and the dungeon below, where Frankenstein's Monster waits. Stitched corpses, haunted armor, gargoyles and tesla constructs guard it. Igor at the gate gives the quests.

Ways in and out: Gatehouse Barracks (west) leads to Winding Path in Sunscorch Dunes; Winding Path (east) leads to Hunters' Chapel in Nightfall Hollow.

Whole area 6 rooms

Surface 25 rooms

Underground 6 rooms

Mars Levels 30 to 40 · Sci-fi · 106 rooms

The planet is at war with Pluto: east of the Twisting Passage is the Martian Fleet Dock (Admiral Glorp, and the warship Crimson Fang that flies to Pluto), and Plutonian raiders prowl the canyons. Reached by the starship Tharsis, docked beside Frostpeak Station (go in, north twice, then launch in the cockpit). A 100-room red planet of little green Martians with ray guns, laid out in a 10 by 10 grid: dust flats and craters near the landing pad, then a canyon of snipers, a Martian city of saucer pilots and officers, and the Overlord's citadel at the far corner. Commander Reyes at the landing pad gives the quests; the Martian Overlord Zorgblat carries the unique Death Ray Gun.

Ways in and out: Dusty Dune (west) leads to Service Walkway in Ember Wastes; Crimson Fang: Bridge (launch the starship) leads to Martian Beachhead in Pluto; Service Walkway (east) leads to Edge of Nothing in The Abyss.

Whole area 3 rooms

Surface 103 rooms

Golden Years Manor Levels 12 to 18 · Modern · 25 rooms

A haunted retirement community at the end of Commerce Avenue (in). Its restless residents are undead and ghosts: zombie grandmas, bingo-calling ghosts, walker wraiths, denture biters and the Queen of Bingo herself, Matriarch Edna, in the Memory Care Wing. Nurse Dolores asks you to put them to rest.

Ways in and out: Activity Room (west) leads to City Block in BroGym; City Block (east) leads to Pink Flamingo Bar in The Pink Flamingo.

Surface 25 rooms

Buckstars Coffee Shop Levels 1 to 4 · Modern · the newbie area · 30 rooms

The starting area for new runners: a 30-room Buckstars Coffee Shop, reached with down from Ashfall Square. Everything you would find in a coffee shop (order counter, espresso bar, pastry case, condiment bar, couches, restrooms, back rooms, drive-thru, dumpster alley) with caffeinated zombies, jittery baristas, ice machine imps and, in the Roasting Room, a level 4 boss: Overcaffeinated Brenda, the store manager. Shift Supervisor Sam gives the quest, and Barista Bree sells coffee, pastries, an apron and a tamper club.

Ways in and out: Buckstars Entrance (up) leads to Ashfall Square in Ashfall Junction.

Whole area 30 rooms

The Mammoth Caverns Levels 26 to 33 · Prehistoric · 25 rooms

A three-level cave system under the Primeval Rift, entered with in from Stegosaur Valley: the painted upper caves of the Mammoth Clan, dripping tunnels with crystals, creepers and a mammoth graveyard, and the deep throne cavern of Grog the Great, a very large caveman with a very large club. Elder Ugga keeps the fire at the cave mouth.

Ways in and out: Cave Mouth (west) leads to Game Trail in The Primeval Rift.

Surface 11 rooms

Underground 10 rooms

Underground 4 rooms

Nightfall Hollow Levels 33 to 39 · Fantasy · 26 rooms

Past the Shattered Citadel's crypt gate (type in) lies a cursed village under a sky with no stars: vampires in their manor, werewolves in the woods, witches at the crossroads and demons at the Brimstone Gate. Father Aldric runs the hunters' chapel.

Ways in and out: Hunters' Chapel (west) leads to Winding Path in Castle Frankenstein; Winding Path (east) leads to Watchtower Top in Shattered Citadel.

Surface 26 rooms
